note: Attacker-controlled input bytes are wrapped into a cfgfile struct with content pointing to the raw fuzz input and size set to the input length.
The cfgfile struct is passed to HAProxy's configuration parser, which reads the content buffer as a text configuration file.

code: parse_cfg processes the content buffer line by line
note: The parser iterates over the input buffer, splitting it into lines and parsing directives; a crafted line can cause an out-of-bounds read past the end of the content buffer.

code: A malformed directive (e.g. unterminated quote or truncated token) is parsed
note: A specially crafted configuration line lacking a terminating newline or containing an incomplete token causes the parser to read beyond the allocated input buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow READ.
